content.text: AMISY ararimbe!
Inya, vatano wapanapatambe AMISY Ai weap,
Weapo AMISY ararimbe!
Syare AMISY Apa tame rararimbe!
Unumeso muno ntoa nuge nuganui,
syare AMISY Apa tame rararimbe tutir!
Nai munijo rani muram uma seo ri
nto nanto no munijo varet uma pasyo rije rai,
no rui rui vayave tamo AMISY wemi rararin.
AMISY opamo akari titi no vombe irati susye kotaro mine so mai,
Apa kovo ntiti mo naume rapapayaje vintabo.
Are pirati indati po wama AMISY amaisy?
Opamo tuna no kursijo titi rai no munijo ntiti.
Weramu beakaje rave ti
Po nugo naume muno mine so raen kava.
Wepi Po vatano ananuge meweno ai aijaseo no anaingkainyo kindua
ama uga rai,
muno vatano mamanaive ai jewene, aijaseo no apa mayondi rai.
Indamu aijaseo tuna akarijo wo nuge raijanande matavon tenambe,
weti apa tame ngkovo akari matavon no kawasae Amisye Apa ura maije mansamun.
Amisye wepi Po akoeyo nte bayave raijaseo no ama yavaruga,
weti ama arikainye inta mansaen no rai,
wemirati akoeyo ranuga ntairi anayanambe rautan
AMISY ararimbe!

footnotes.text: Kindua omamo anaingkainyo wanijate vatane wo raisyaniv.
